title: The element $\sqrt{q}$ and the ribbon structure
html:
Remark. The element \sqrt{q} and the ribbon structure

The element v := q^{1/2} constitutes post-Archimedean naming. A ribbon structure on \mathbf{C} demands a natural twist \varTheta_V \colon V \xrightarrow{\sim} V. On the defining \mathrm{SU}_q(2) representation, the twist axiom forces \varTheta_V = q^{1/2}\mathrm{id}_V. The binary sign choice on v dictates the spin structure on the realized worldline.
